summary:
- [AIDASoft/DD4hep#1663](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1663) — `Geant4Output2EDM4hep`/`LCIO`/`ROOT` now correctly retrieve run info from the worker context in multi-threaded mode, fixing missing run/file parameters and locking issues in the output writers; also adds a test comparing run and metadata trees. Important correctness fix for multi-threaded ddsim output.
- [AIDASoft/DD4hep#1681](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1681) — Removes the CSG-based DDCAD/ASSIMP CAD exporter because ROOT made `RCsg`/`CsgOps.h` private. This is a temporary functionality removal to restore builds against current ROOT; a replacement using public ROOT interfaces is being worked on in #1682.
- [AIDASoft/DD4hep#1666](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1666) — Adds a new `kUpstreamTrapezoid` mask type in `OtherDetectorHelpers.h` to support non-cylindrically-symmetric FCC MDI Synchrotron Radiation Mask geometries (paired with k4geo#648).
- [key4hep/k4geo#658](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/658) — Introduces `MuSIC_v3`: instruments each nozzle with three silicon Forward Tracker disks, reduces vertex barrel/endcap layers and fixes their IDs, and removes the yoke iron so the HCAL barrel serves as the flux return. Major update for the Muon Collider detector concept.
- [key4hep/k4geo#662](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/662) — Maps geometry volumes to their nearest predefined ROOT color, improving visualization consistency (part of the ongoing effort in k4geo#616 and root2gltf#15).
- [key4hep/EDM4hep#524](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/524) — Hides the deprecated `Track::getTrackState(int32_t)` overload from Cling/cppyy, working around a Python binding issue where cppyy selected the wrong overload (fixes #523).
- [key4hep/k4FWCore#431](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/431) — Adds `--evt-max` as a `k4run` alias for the Gaudi event limit, making it explicit that it corresponds to `ApplicationMgr.EvtMax`. User-visible CLI improvement.
- [key4hep/k4FWCore#427](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/427) — Refactors test components to the functional algorithm API: replaces legacy ROOT-file and Marlin-wrapper producers with functional equivalents, consolidates CellID metadata validation, and centralizes expected output-collection definitions.
- [key4hep/k4ActsTracking#98](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/98) — Adapts k4ActsTracking to the updated ACTS propagator and grid-bin-finder APIs (acts-project/acts#6004); note that this breaks builds against older tagged ACTS releases, prompting discussion about switching Key4hep nightlies to tagged ACTS.
- [key4hep/k4ActsTracking#104](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/104) — Handles the new `TrackingGeometryMaterial` struct from ACTS while retaining support for released ACTS versions that use a pair-based interface.
- [key4hep/k4ActsTracking#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/97) — Makes `--compactFile` a required argument in `CLD_CKFTracking.py`, `runGNNTrackFinding.py`, and `test_visualize_acts_geo.py`, replacing a cryptic Gaudi `TypeError` with a clear argparse error.
- [key4hep/k4GaudiPandora#54](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora/pull/54) — Fixes PFO comparison to be compatible with the current EDM4hep (adapts to EDM4hep#520).
- [HEP-FCC/root2gltf#15](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/15) — Shrinks children volumes overlapping with parents, reduces default `numFaces` to 1000, raises transparency to 100%, and cleans up the conversion pipeline, producing clearer detector visualizations (with sample renderings for ALLEGRO, CLD and IDEA).
- [HEP-FCC/FCC-config#386](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/386) — Extends the tracking-validation CLI option to IDEA full-sim digitization/reconstruction and exposes it via IDEA and ALLEGRO ctest wrappers (`--addTruthTracks`, `--runTrkValidation`).
- [HEP-FCC/FCCeePhysicsStudies#61](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCeePhysicsStudies/pull/61) — Adds updated FSR lattice beam parameters (still GHC-based, since LCC values above the Z pole are not yet available).
